cues.text: Stop doing hundreds of push-ups that
look tough but build nothing. Let me fix
that. You only need three simple form
fixes and you'll look stronger
instantly. First hand placement. Most
guys go too wide or too close. Go
shoulder width apart, fingers slightly
out. That's where your chest, shoulders,
[music] and triceps actually work
together. Second range of motion. Half
[music] reps equals half results. Go all
the way down until your chest nearly
touches the floor. Then push up with
power. Don't flare your elbows like a
chicken. [music] Third, core control. If
your hips are sagging or popping up,
you're basically doing bad yoga, not
push-ups. Keep your body straight from
neck to heels. Like a solid plank that
moves. That's it. Three small fixes,
massive difference. No fancy gym, no
equipment, just clean push-ups equals
clean gains.
